title: DELETE /api/projects/:id/todos/:tid — delete to-do
description: Delete a todo permanently and recalculate project progress.
acceptanceCriteria: DELETE requires auth and project ownership

steps.details: 1) getOwnedProject. 2) Find todo by id AND project_id. 3) Delete todo. 4) Call recalculateProgress(projectId). 5) Return 200 { message: 'Todo deleted', progress: newProgress }.
Create 2 todos, complete 1, delete it — verify progress updates from 50% to 0% (1 todo remaining, uncompleted).
